notes.key_messages: Candidates are advised to: • use single words and not to reuse examples when completing the form in Question 1 , • respond to all parts of Question 2 in the tense indicated, • use simple linking words in Question 2 , for example when giving opinions/explanations, • choose the option in Question 3 which allows them to show what they know, • give brief additional details in response to individual tasks in Question 3 , • plan and organise answers into a coherent piece of writing, using extended sentences where possible.
